title: Race Matters / Sonidos Ancestrales con Weyón

rows.title: Gift
notes: “I want to leave you with this final track, which is the first single release from Way's EP Wanda Ihara titled Gift. Enjoy.”

Sydney experimental artist Weyón's track 'Gift' opens their release Wonder y Horror on Bandcamp; 'Wanda Ihara' is almost certainly an ASR mishearing of 'Wonder y Horror' (also surfaced as 'GIFT [DEMO]' on an NTS Live guest mix).
